== Biography ==
David Glasgow was born on 24 October 1765 and baptised on 2 November 1765 in Edinburgh, Midlothian, Scotland. The parish transcript names his father as Abraham Glasgow, a wright, his mother as May Ormiston, and their residence as Pleasance.<ref name="FMP">"Scotland, Parish Births & Baptisms 1564–1929," Findmypast transcript, [https://www.findmypast.co.uk/transcript?id=SCOT%2FOPR%2FBAP%2F0729726&tab=this David Glasgow, SCOT/OPR/BAP/0729726] (reviewed 23 October 2026), birth 24 October and baptism 2 November 1765, Edinburgh; Abraham Glasgow, wright, and May Ormiston, residence Pleasance; citing OPR 685_2/8, item 3, p. 212. Original register image uninspected.</ref> The existing family account links them as [[Glasgow-1235|Abraham Glasgow]] and [[Ormistoun-12|May Ormistoun]]; the recorded father-to-adult-profile identification remains probable. The record place and residence do not independently establish David's exact birthplace.
